effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Belphemon: Rage Mode] from your trash on top of this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon can't attack and isn't affected by your opponent's effects until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may trash 2 cards in your hand to end the attack.
